lines.text: Anything not fully specified gets /but-first-planning:grill (one question at a time, each with a recommended answer) before it is planned or handed to a session you will not watch.

The plan lives in .agents/plan/: a spec decision changes through /but-first-planning:spec-edit, and an issue is built from its acceptance criteria as failing tests first (/but-first-planning:build-tdd).

chains.text: A published plan is worked through /agent-works:orchestrate: its issues show on the board as cards.
